title: Registered predictions: homogeneous mode jointly with the direct geodesic release (addendum to registered_predictions_homogeneous_mode_2026-10-29.json)
theory: Entropic Scalar EFT; trace-coupled homogeneous mode with onset at z_c = 3400 (matter-radiation equality), abundance tie omega_c = 5.333 omega_b, direct geodesic release history (Section 20)

method.likelihood: Planck 2018 plik-lite TTTEEE + low-ell TT bins, DESI DR2 BAO, DES-Dovekie SN, sum m_nu = 0.06 eV, tau prior 0.0506 +- 0.0086, free calibration
method.mode_proxy: CAMB EarlyQuintessence, n = 3, theta_i = 2.83, peak fraction f_EDE at z_c (one added amplitude)
method.joint_evaluation: CMB = CMB[mode + Lambda at joint theta*] + (CMB[release] - CMB[Lambda at release theta*]); BAO/SN from the release background with the mode's r_drag; f_EDE -> 0 reproduces the release fit to Delta chi2 = 0.02
method.code: harness_joint.py, abundance_joint.py, fisher_joint.py (02 Research/Homogeneous mode fit 2026-10-29/joint)

f_EDE=0.07.note: release history driven outside its physical range

J1_H0.falsifier: local H0 >= 73 with 1 km/s/Mpc uncertainty excludes the mode with the abundance tie at 3 sigma

J2_a0.falsifier: a 2% galactic a0 inconsistent with eps c H0 for the measured H0

J3_rdrag.value: r_drag = 146.4 Mpc (joint best fit; 147.3 without the mode, 144.7 at f_EDE = 0.05)

J4_high_z_halos.falsifier: a high-z halo or bright-galaxy excess over LambdaCDM of order 3x or more at z >= 12 that survives star-formation modelling is not produced by the mode (the tie caps it near 1.4x)

J5_clusters_z1.98.note: unchanged by the mode (release-only 1.22, 1.27); XLSSC 122-like clusters are not a test of the mode

caveats: proxy potential in place of the unspecified mode potential
split evaluation neglects cross terms between the mode and the release lensing/ISW change (second order)
halo ratios use linear power with Sheth-Tormen (z >= 10) and Tinker 200m (z = 1.98) mass functions
